intro: Brunei is an absolute monarchy where the sultan is also prime minister.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah is head of state and government and holds several ministries. A Legislative Council advises him; most members are appointed. Islamic sharia law applies alongside civil law.

chapters.title: ASEAN
text: Brunei joined ASEAN in 1984, the same year it became independent.
